speaker: narrator
text: 在世界的尽头，有一片从来没有船经过的海。
en: At the edge of the world, there is a sea where no ship has ever sailed.

speaker: narrator
text: 海中央，有一座小小的灯塔。灯塔里，住着一个老机器人。
en: In the middle of it stands a tiny lighthouse. And in the lighthouse lives an old robot.

speaker: narrator
text: 他的名字，叫阿灯。
en: His name is Deng.

speaker: deng
text: 晚上好，大海。今天，也要好好发光哦。
en: Good evening, sea. Let's shine our best tonight, too.

speaker: narrator
text: 三百年来，阿灯每天晚上都会点亮灯塔。可是，从来没有一艘船来过。
en: For three hundred years, Deng has lit the lighthouse every night. But not a single ship has ever come.

speaker: deng
text: 要是有人，能看见这束光，就好了。
en: If only someone could see this light.

speaker: deng
text: 咦？那是，什么？
en: Huh? What... is that?

speaker: deng
text: 掉进海里了！
en: It fell into the sea!

speaker: guang
text: 呜呜，好冷，好黑。
en: Hic... so cold... so dark...

speaker: deng
text: 别怕，别怕。我叫阿灯。你是从天上掉下来的吗？
en: Don't be scared. I'm Deng. Did you fall from the sky?

speaker: guang
text: 我叫小光。我在天上追流星，一不小心，就掉下来了。
en: I'm Guang. I was chasing shooting stars, and... I slipped and fell.

speaker: guang
text: 天亮以前，我一定要回家。不然，我就会熄灭的。
en: I have to get home before sunrise. Or else... my light will go out.

speaker: deng
text: 别担心。我们一起想办法！
en: Don't worry. We'll figure it out together!

speaker: deng
text: 一、二、三，飞！
en: One, two, three... fly!

speaker: guang
text: 哈哈，再高一点！
en: Haha! Higher!

speaker: deng
text: 那就，再高一点！
en: Then... higher it is!

speaker: guang
text: 哈哈哈！阿灯，你好笨呀！
en: Hahaha! Deng, you're so clumsy!

speaker: guang
text: 阿灯，你一直都是一个人吗？
en: Deng... have you always been alone?

speaker: deng
text: 是啊。不过今天晚上，不是了。
en: Yes. But not tonight.

speaker: guang
text: 阿灯，我好像，越来越暗了。
en: Deng... I think I'm getting dimmer.

speaker: deng
text: 灯塔的光，能照得很远很远。也许，也能照到天上！
en: The lighthouse can shine very, very far. Maybe... all the way to the sky!

speaker: deng
text: 还不够，还差一点点。
en: Not enough... just a little more.

speaker: guang
text: 阿灯，那是你的心。不要！
en: Deng, that's your heart. Don't!

speaker: deng
text: 三百年了，我一直在等一艘船。
en: For three hundred years, I've been waiting for a ship.

speaker: deng
text: 原来，我等的，是你。
en: Now I know. I was waiting for you.

speaker: guang
text: 阿灯，阿灯！
en: Deng! Deng!

speaker: deng
text: 回家吧，小光。
en: Go home, Guang.

speaker: whale
text: 谢谢你，守灯人。
en: Thank you, keeper of the light.

speaker: guang
text: 阿灯！以后每天晚上，我都会在天上，看着你！
en: Deng! Every night from now on, I'll be up there, watching you!

speaker: deng
text: 好。我也会一直，为你发光。
en: Okay. And I'll keep shining for you. Always.

speaker: narrator
text: 从那以后，每当阿灯点亮灯塔，天上总有一颗星星，一闪，一闪，回答他。
en: From then on, whenever Deng lit the lighthouse, one star in the sky would twinkle back. Blink. Blink.

speaker: narrator
text: 原来，每一束光，都会被看见。
en: Because every light, in the end, is seen by someone.
